description_en: Retrieves the uplink and downlink data packets of a specific node
description_zh: 调用GetNodeTransferPacket获取某条节点上下行数据包
name: GetNodeTransferPacket

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the Alibaba Cloud Link WAN console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The DevEUI associated with the data packet. The value is a 16-character hexadecimal string
parameters.name: dev_eui

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded MACPayload message. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109959.html operation to query this value
parameters.help_zh: Base64编码后的MACPayload报文，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109959.html接口查询获取
parameters.name: base64_encoded_mac_payload

parameters.help_en: The sending time of the data packet. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109959.html operation to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 数据包的发送时间，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109959.html接口查询获取
parameters.name: log_millis

Data.description_en: The data packet information returned when the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时返回的数据包信息列表

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used when sending or receiving this data packet
ClassMode.description_zh: 收发此数据包时的LoRaWAN Class模式

Datr.description_en: The data rate for sending or receiving this data packet
Datr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的数据速率

DevAddr.description_en: The network address of the node that sent or received this data packet
DevAddr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的网络地址

DevEui.description_en: The DevEUI of the node that sent or received this data packet
DevEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的DevEUI

FPort.description_en: The FPort used to send or receive this data packet
FPort.description_zh: 收发此数据包时所使用的FPort

Freq.description_en: The frequency used to send or receive this data packet

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by the gateway through which the data packet passed
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 数据包所经过的网关所采用的频段ID

GwEui.description_en: The GwEUI of the gateway through which this data packet was sent or received
GwEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包所经过的网关的GwEUI

GwOwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account of the user who owns the gateway through which the data packet passed
GwOwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 数据包所经过网关所属用户的阿里云账号

HasData.description_en:
Indicates whether this data packet contains business data. Valid values:

true: The data packet contains business data.
false: The data packet does not contain business data
HasData.description_zh:
此数据包中是否包含业务数据。返回值：

true：包含。
false：不包含

HasMacCommand.description_en:
Indicates whether this data packet contains MAC instructions. Valid values:

true: The data packet contains MAC instructions.
false: The data packet does not contain MAC instructions
HasMacCommand.description_zh:
此数据包中是否包含MAC指令。返回值：

true：包含。
false：不包含

LogMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the data packet transmission, in milliseconds
LogMillis.description_zh: 数据包传输的UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

Lsnr.description_en: The signal-to-noise ratio for sending or receiving this data packet
Lsnr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的信噪比

items.description_en: The list of MAC instructions carried by this data packet
items.description_zh: 这个数据包所携带的MAC指令列表

MacPayloadSize.description_en: The length of the MACPayload message in this data packet

MessageType.description_en:
The message type. Valid values:

JOIN_REQUEST: Join-request message.
JOIN_ACCEPT: Join-accept message.
UNCONFIRMED_UP: Unconfirmed uplink message.
UNCONFIRMED_DOWN: Unconfirmed downlink message.
CONFIRMED_UP: Confirmed uplink message.
CONFIRMED_DOWN: Confirmed downlink message.
REJOIN_REQUEST: Rejoin-request message.
PROPRIETARY: Proprietary message
MessageType.description_zh:
消息类型。返回值：

JOIN_REQUEST：Join-request消息。
JOIN_ACCEPT：Join-accept消息。
UNCONFIRMED_UP：Unconfirmed上行消息。
UNCONFIRMED_DOWN：Unconfirmed下行消息。
CONFIRMED_UP：Confirmed上行消息。
CONFIRMED_DOWN：Confirmed下行消息。
REJOIN_REQUEST：Rejoin-request消息。
PROPRIETARY：Proprietary消息（私有消息）

ProcessEvent.description_en:
The processing result of the message. Valid values:

SUCCESS: Successful.
DEVADDR_ILLEGAL: The DevAddr is invalid.
MIC_FAIL: The MIC verification failed.
DEVEUI_ILLEGAL: The DevEUI is invalid.
JOINEUI_ILLEGAL: The JoinEUI is invalid.
STATUS_INVALID: The node status is invalid.
REDUPLICATE: Duplicate packet.
ISOLATED: Inter-network isolation.
APPKEY_ILLEGAL: The AppKey is invalid.
UPDATE_RUNTIME_CFG_FAIL: Failed to update the runtime configuration.
DELAY_PROCESS: Delayed processing.
GWEUI_ILLEGAL: The GwEUI is invalid.
GW_STATUS_INVALID: The gateway status is invalid.
GW_FREQ_NOT_MATCH: The gateway frequency does not match.
Other: Unknown error
ProcessEvent.description_zh:
该报文的处理结果。返回值：

SUCCESS：成功。
DEVADDR_ILLEGAL：DevAddr不合法。
MIC_FAIL：MIC校验失败。
DEVEUI_ILLEGAL：DevEUI不合法。
JOINEUI_ILLEGAL：JoinEUI不合法。
STATUS_INVALID：节点状态不合法。
REDUPLICATE：重复包。
ISOLATED：网间隔离。
APPKEY_ILLEGAL：AppKey不合法。
UPDATE_RUNTIME_CFG_FAIL：更新运行时配置失败。
DELAY_PROCESS：延迟处理。
GWEUI_ILLEGAL：GwEUI不合法。
GW_STATUS_INVALID：网关状态不合法。
GW_FREQ_NOT_MATCH：网关频点不匹配。
其它：未知错误

Rssi.description_en: The RSSI for sending or receiving this data packet

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。返回值：
true：调用成功。
** false**：调用失败
